newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA MAY USE TAXES TO CUT IMPORTS - ANWAR.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA MAY USE TAXES TO CUT IMPORTS - ANWAR.

text.p: Malaysia could use higher taxes and other fiscal measures to discourage imports and boost the country's exports, Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said on Thursday.
"We will have to take fiscal and tax measures to reduce imports and increase exports," Anwar said at the opening of a capital markets conference.
He said the annual budget for 1998 will address some of these issues.
Anwar, who is also finance minister, said the government was concerned with the ballooning of trade deficit to 2.8 billion ringgit in June this year.
In April, Malaysia reported a surplus of 156.2 million ringgit in May.
